name: Android Live Transcribe
description: Android accessibility feature/app that captures speech and selected sounds and displays them as text, with options for typed responses and other communication controls.
intended_use: Inspect real-time speech-to-text as a possible communication-access aid in conversations or environments where hearing or spoken processing is difficult.
audience_or_context: People with compatible Android devices who want live transcription or text-supported communication.
limitations: Accuracy depends on language, audio conditions, device and connectivity; transcription errors can change meaning.
Microphone use and conversation privacy need consideration, especially around sensitive information.
Feature availability, offline language support and device integration vary.
cost_or_access_notes: Free on compatible Android devices; some functions require internet access or specific hardware.
conflicts_of_interest: Google develops Android and the feature; ND Oracle lists capability and limitations without adopting accessibility or accuracy claims beyond documented function.

provenance.method: Current first-party identity, access route and stated function checked on 2026-08-28. Listing records what the resource is and how to reach it without adopting provider claims of benefit.
